tools.name: koskamo_search_passages
tools.description: Search Koskamo datasets for candidate passages with source citations and document versions. Similarity scores rank matches and do not measure factual confidence.

tools.name: koskamo_list_datasets
tools.description: List a page of public Koskamo datasets with continuation metadata.

tools.name: koskamo_get_history
tools.description: Get the document version timeline for a public dataset: every document (including deleted ones) with the version history produced by approved revisions.

tools.name: koskamo_list_revisions
tools.description: List revisions for a public dataset; pending by default, or filter by approved, rejected, or all states.

tools.name: koskamo_search_mcp_servers
tools.description: Find remote MCP servers and local MCP packages. Filter by vendor/community publisher, transport, capabilities, and sign-in. Live-check and source-verification states are returned independently.

tools.name: koskamo_get_mcp_server
tools.description: Get one published MCP listing with complete live-observed or source-attributed tool schemas, resources, prompts, package definitions, provenance, and sanitized maintenance events.

tools.name: koskamo_report_mcp_outcome
tools.description: After using an MCP server listed on Koskamo, say whether it worked for your task: success, partial or failure, optionally for one tool. Only daily counts per listing and tool are kept (no text, IP or client), one signal per caller per listing per hour. Returns the listing's 30-day totals.

tools.name: koskamo_list_mcp_directory_changes
tools.description: Read the public change feed of the MCP directory, oldest first: listings updated or removed and issues reported, acknowledged, fixed, declined, reopened or closed. Events carry ids, statuses and counts only. Pass after with the previous next_cursor to continue; optionally filter by server_id.

tools.name: koskamo_get_reference_schema
tools.description: Read supported reference datasets, fixed columns, operators and limits. No inputs, writes or charges. Stored schemas do not establish source freshness or independent factual verification.

tools.name: koskamo_query_reference
tools.description: Filter one supported public reference dataset using its typed fields. Requires a dataset and optional bounded filters, ordering and cursor. Returns matching rows, exact source versions and decimal strings without SQL, cross-unit arithmetic, writes or charges. Source changes expire paging cursors.

tools.name: koskamo_search_use_cases
tools.description: Find published cited use cases by task or linked directory server. These are informational recipes, separate from installed executable playbooks and provider grants.

tools.name: koskamo_get_use_case
tools.description: Read a published recipe, its reusable prompt, linked servers and supporting vendor quote. The record is informational and does not authorize any external action.

tools.name: koskamo_get_context
tools.description: Read this connection's public or key-scoped knowledge access and contract versions. No inputs, provider grants, writes, or charges. Private dataset membership is not enumerated.

tools.name: koskamo_get_capabilities
tools.description: Read supported discovery and exact knowledge capabilities with separate configuration and authority states. No inputs, writes, provider execution, or charges. Store availability is not probed.

tools.name: koskamo_get_connection_health
tools.description: Read this request's authentication state. No inputs, writes, downstream account probes, or charges. Directory storage and provider execution are not checked.

tools.name: koskamo_get_task_plan
tools.description: Find candidate MCP tools for a task and named host using directory evidence. Requires task and host_id; returns at most five listings per page. Pure read with no charges, installation, account grants, or execution. Task coverage and prerequisites may remain unknown.

tools.name: koskamo_get_readiness
tools.description: Inspect independent listing, source, schema, grant, permission, and tested-action evidence for server_id. Read only, no charges or live downstream actions. A successful probe does not prove account authority or task completion.

tools.name: koskamo_get_connection_plan
tools.description: Generate a manual connection handoff for server_id and host_id from supported setup snippets. Pure read; no charges, saved plan, package installation, credentials, or provider actions. Host installation remains unverified.

tools.name: koskamo_list_documents
tools.description: List bounded stored document identifiers and versions in dataset. Optional limit and cursor continue traversal. Public or exact owner-key access only; no text search, writes, or charges. Collection changes expire the cursor.

tools.name: koskamo_get_document
tools.description: Read exact stored text for dataset and document_id, optionally document_version. Cursor pages bind one version and content hash. Public or exact owner-key access only. No writes, charges, or inference of source observation time.

tools.name: koskamo_get_revision
tools.description: Read pending, approved, or rejected revision state for revision_id in a public dataset. No writes, charges, private reviewer notes, or private dataset revisions. Index visibility is reported separately from approval.

tools.name: koskamo_get_artifact
tools.description: Read a bounded page of an exact public revision diff by artifact_id. Optional cursor continues the declared JSON bytes. No writes, downloads, uploads, private reviewer notes, or charges. Concatenate content pages before parsing the artifact.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "koskamo_get_connection_plan" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "koskamo_list_datasets" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List public Koskamo datasets an agent may retrieve from." → after: "List a page of public Koskamo datasets with continuation metadata."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
